title: nuryel.state/1 frozen as code: scope model, seven facets, three verbs, canonical ids, seven asserted invariants — additive, unwired
context: Step 3 of the deterministic-state plan (private topics vision.deterministic-state-layer, architecture.single-integration-surface, roadmap.sofia-state-pilot). The fold spike (fnd_3066259a35) retired the only risk ahead of it. The Sofia baseline is running (fnd_a02076f480, fnd_9c863eaa82). Branch nuryel/state-contract: src/core/stateContract.ts, test/state-contract.test.ts, docs/nuryel-state-contract.md. Proposed until the maintainer reads and accepts the contract; nothing depends on it yet.
decision: Freeze the one contract every orchestrator speaks to the state layer as schemas, not prose, with no behaviour change: nothing is wired into the store, CLI or MCP. Scope model: organization › team › user › repository as partitions of one graph; principals carry grants and authorization is decided against grants before retrieval and asserted again on the way out. Facets: decided (Decision, exists), in force (Constraint / valid_to, exists), done (nuryel.receipt/1 ActionReceipt — identity is the action, so a re-sent action replays the same receipt), committed (nuryel.commitment/1 with an in-force window), changed (credential-free ExternalRef version pointer), current (nuryel.derived/1 DerivedState with MANDATORY dependencies; identity ignores dependency order), entity/relationship (nuryel.entity/1 kind-qualified like Landscape resources, nuryel.relationship/1 with edge identity), DNA (hunch.project-dna/1 keyed by scope, no new schema). Verbs: read bound to the existing delivery envelope receipt with a state_of_record block (current, in_force, done, depends_on, invalidated_by) and named denied_scopes; write with mandatory provenance + idempotency key returning durability pushed|committed|local and outcome created|updated|replayed|superseded with an explicit conflict; subscribe as a strictly ordered change stream where a gap forces resynchronization; capability negotiation that names unsupported capabilities. Canonical form: keys sorted by code unit at every level, undefined dropped, non-finite numbers rejected; stateHash over it; ids derived from what makes two records the same fact. Seven invariants exported as data and enforced by assertions or schema rules: authorization-before-retrieval, similarity-never-authorizes, never-in-request-path, provenance-on-every-write, one-live-decision-per-topic, external-truth-stays-external, derived-state-carries-dependencies.
consequences: Every facet was lifted from a record Sofia already keeps (approvals, follow-ups, cited summaries, dossiers + links, user rules), so the pilot's adapter is a mapping, not an invention.

Backward compatibility by construction: no existing record changes shape, scope defaults to repository, new facets are new kinds an older reader ignores, JSON schema version untouched; delivery envelope, change proof and Project DNA keep their ids as sub-schemas.

Not decided here and listed as such in the doc: per-record visibility inside a scope (v1 permission model is partition-level grants, GitHub's repo model), store registration of the new kinds (blast radius: kind registry, jsonStore, overlay-safety, private-migrate, MCP surface, gitignore whitelist), the served organization partition mode, naming.
The credential detector gained a bare-secret check (ghp_, github_pat_, sk-, xox*, AKIA, JWT shapes) because the general detector only sees assignments, bearer values, key blocks and URL userinfo.
Bindings (HTTP, MCP, CLI, typed client) are the next step and must be generated from these schemas, never hand-maintained beside them — or the single surface becomes four.
alternatives_rejected: Freezing the contract as a document only: prose cannot be round-trip tested, hashed or asserted; the dossier's own 120-task program shows where prose contracts drift.

Registering the new record kinds in the store in the same step: touches the kind registry, jsonStore, overlay-safety, private-migrate and the MCP surface at once — the contract should be rejectable before that blast radius is spent.

Reusing the Landscape ResourceSchema directly for external entities: its currentness fields are repository-revision-shaped; entities keep the kind-qualified identity rule and lifecycle but carry provenance pointers instead.
Storing derived content by reference only (hash without text): the state layer must be able to deliver the statement; the hash guards integrity, the text is the state.
A similarity or score field anywhere in the verbs: would let a binding treat similarity as validity; the invariant test asserts no verb schema admits one.
